title: Fingerprint requirements and instructions for SFMO licenses
license: Public Texas government text (TDI / State Fire Marshal). Verify against the live page before relying on fees or dates.

sections.heading: Steps for getting your fingerprints at IdentoGO:

items: Credit cards: Visa, MasterCard, Discover, and American Express

blocks.text: Personal checks and cash are not accepted.
Your fingerprints will be sent electronically to the DPS and the FBI. You won’t get a printed fingerprint card.
The IdentoGO agent will give you a receipt.

items: Attach a copy of the receipt to your application.
Keep the original receipt for your records.

sections.heading: Steps for getting hard card ink fingerprints

blocks.text: If electronic fingerprinting isn’t available, you can get hard card ink fingerprints.

items: Credit cards: Visa, MasterCard, Discover, and American Express

blocks.text: If you fill out the online form, the confirmation document will be emailed to you. If you call, the confirmation document will be mailed to you.
Get a copy of your fingerprints from a criminal law enforcement agency.

items: You will need to show your photo ID.

Get a complete set of your fingerprints on an approved FBI fingerprint card from a local law enforcement agency. The cost for obtaining an ink card may vary and is not included in the Texas Background fee.
The card must be signed by you and the official taking the fingerprints.

blocks.text: Mail your fingerprints and confirmation document to IdentoGO. The address is on the confirmation document. Don’t mail your fingerprints and confirmation document to SFMO – this will delay the processing of your application.
IdentoGO will mail a receipt to you. You can check the status by going to the IdentoGO website and clicking “Check the Status of your Service.”
Attach a copy of the receipt to your application. Keep the original receipt for your records.
